utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone. Bonjour, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Bonjour, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Before we begin today, the Chamber will issue a brief oral ruling. On 13th January, 2012, the Chamber ordered that the United Kingdom's motion to reclassify response to invitation to the United Kingdom filed on 10th of January, 2012, be reclassified as public. On 20th of January, 2012, the UK filed the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland's response to the submissions regarding the reclassification of its filing on 5th of January, 2012, in which it requested the Chamber to redact certain portions of its response of 5th of January prior to reclassifying it as public. The Chamber grants the request as contained in paragraph 6 of the UK response of 20th of January and orders that the UK may file a public version redacting those portions indicated therein. Further, the unredacted version of the 5th of January response should remain as confidential. Thank you. Yes, Mr. Mitchell, please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good morning.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: I want to start off by just going back to something we talked about very briefly yesterday. If you can look at page 38 of the book that's in front of you. That's 65 ter 3199. It's page 48 in e-court. And, Mr. Ruez, the transcript yesterday recorded you saying - this was from page T23644: "... this is the view from close to the asphalt road where the Bosnian Serb was present, and the men were on top of the hills ..." Is there something missing from that when you say "close to the asphalt road where the Bosnian Serb was present"?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, the Bosnian Serb Army.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you. Let's move to page 46 now. It's page 56 in e-court. We're going to see another map here, and if you can describe to us where -- where the next location we're going to look at is and if you can locate that for us on this map.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So now, as I said, we are entering the spots where executions took place, and this one points a location in the so-called Cerska Valley.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay. What was the first information you received that made Cerska Valley a place of interest?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It -- it was a combination of two -- two witnesses. The first one was on 13 July overlooking this area from the top of the hill that I described as being the hill overlooking the intersection of Konjevic Polje, and from there he could see three buses entering this -- the entrance of this valley. These three buses were escorted by APCs. And shortly after he lost of sight these buses, there was a small excavator who followed the same track and also entered the valley. Shortly afterwards, he heard intense shooting coming from that direction. This is what the first witness reported. And another one who managed to cross during the night, this area, who had lost his shoes during the trip, walked at one point on sticky material that he identified as being a pool of blood, and he continued his way towards the top of the valley.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay. If I -- I'll just stop you there and we'll go on and look at some of the photos now. If we go to the next page, please, page 47 in the book and page 40 -- 57 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, before you explain the black arrow, can you orient us on the road that we see on the bottom right-hand side of the picture.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So totally at the right of the picture is the hill overlooking -- the above intersection and also the area that leads towards Nova Kasaba, and in front of that -- the line shows, in fact, the direction of this dirt road that leads to the entrance of Cerska Valley.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: That's the black arrow.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the black arrow, indeed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And the road on the right-hand side that we can see that curves in and then back out of the picture, where does that road lead to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one is the road that leads from Konjevic Polje. That would be in direction of the top right, and towards Nova Kasaba, bottom right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 47 -- 48 in the book and 58 in e-court. Can you describe what we see on this picture.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It is the opposite view seen this time from the beginning of the -- the entrance of Cerska Valley and looking towards the hill which is the one overlooking all this area on which the witness was when he saw these buses entering the valley.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, I might actually get you to mark on this map where the roads are heading.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If I could ask the usher to assist.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So this is the direction towards Nova Kasaba. This is the direction towards Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: How far is Konjevic Polje from this intersection that we see here?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Maybe more than 1 kilometre but not so much more.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And Nova Kasaba?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Probably 3, 4. And this one is the direction to Cerska.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And how far down this road into the Cerska Valley is the site that we're going to be looking at where the bodies were discovered?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Maybe 2 kilometres.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. President, if I can tender that --

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, if you can put your initials in the bottom right-hand corner and today's date.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are the 27th?

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: 27th, yes.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: This will be admitted.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4280, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we go to the next page, please, page 49 in the book, 59 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, can you describe what we see on this photo, where this road is leading to.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the dirt road that enters the Cerska Valley, and it's more or less where the first of these three Humvees is located. That one who is overlooking the area loses -- starts to lose the sight of the buses.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall what year this picture was taken in?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It was in 1996. We might have a date on one of these pictures. Well, we don't have a date, but --

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Was this your first trip to the area?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it was not the first trip, because during the first mission in Cerska Valley we didn't find the -- the spot, so we drove along the entire valley filming -- filming everything on the way up and then on the way down. Then the video was shown to a witness who walked in the pool of blood, and he's the one who pinpointed an area where we had a reference point. So on another mission we came back to -- to the place. Thanks to this information, we identified a suspect area, and this is the area that we then probed and found the spot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next photo, please, page 50, and page 60 in e-court. If you can just briefly describe what this is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So again this is the -- the dirt road leading to the -- to the suspect spot, and this is to show that it's quite a remote and hidden location. Indeed, totally at this point out of sight of anyone who would be on the opposite side of the valley even on -- on a hill.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page, please, page 51 in the book and 61 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, I might ask you to mark some things on this photo. If you can just explain what this photo shows.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the -- the area that we considered as suspect. In fact, initially for the simple reason that on the -- on the right side of this picture -- in fact, this is the direction of the entrance of the valley, and this is the direction of Cerska.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: So this shot is taken looking back in the direction that you came from.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, correct. And what was in fact suspect here was all these branches that were put on the -- on the side of the road and had no specific reason to be there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you put number 1 there.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay. Can you put your initials on that and the date.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. That will be Exhibit P4281.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Instead of 2011, I believe it's 2012.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: That's correct. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Oh, sorry. I didn't realise we had changed the year already.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we can go to the next page, page 52, 62 in e-court. And if you can orient us on this picture and then describe what this picture shows.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a better view of the suspect area, but it's seen now reversed. The pen doesn't want to ... So the top is the direction of Cerska this time and the bottom -- the vehicles are pointing to drive back to -- towards the entrance.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can you mark on there that suspect area again?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: A bit further here.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can mark that with a number 1.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, is there any significance to the dirt area that we see on the right-hand side of the picture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, indeed, there is. In fact, the little excavator who came after the three buses took soil from this area 2 in order to dump the soil on top of the bodies that fell along this slope here.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you. If you can initial and date that.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Exhibit P4282.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we move to page 53 in the book, 63 in e-court. I won't get to you mark anything on the next picture, Mr. Ruez, but if you can just very quickly tell us what we're looking at now.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: One thing that was not obvious on the previous photographs is that there is a quite steep slope in this area, so the execution area being at the -- at the top where the -- the people are standing and where the vehicle is parked. The bodies then fell along this slope, and the -- the soil that is covering this slope is the soil that was taken by the excavator on the disturbed area that we saw on the previous picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, please, page 54, and 64 in e-court. Now, if you can explain what's happening in this picture, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. So on every site we go to and where we suspect we could find bodies, the thing that we do is we probe the area in order to determine the presence of bodies, and always the presence of multiple bodies, so that after that we can now spark an exhumation process, and to do so we need to show the presence of multiple bodies.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: How do you do a probe?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first thing that is done is to use a probe. That is a long metal stick that is planted inside the soil, going at least 1.5 metre deep, and the technique is very basic since after that this probe is taken out of the soil, and you need to sniff the top of it in order to identify the smell as being the smell of dead bodies. This is a process that we call among us "pick and sniff."

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And what happens after you've done that initial probe? What's the next step in investigating a site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So on this one we decided to -- to dig at three locations that we estimated being among the suspect area. So here at this moment you can see three people starting to dig the surface until we -- we hit something.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And is each of those individuals is in a different pit?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely. Everyone is doing his part of the work on three different locations on this slope.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And this photo was also taken in 1996?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: 1996, yes. I don't remember the month precisely.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we go to the next photo, please, page 55 in the book, 65 in e-court. Can you describe what we see here?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the result of the search on the first little trench, and at the bottom of the picture, which is more or less the bottom of the slope, one can see two -- two legs with two feet.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now can we go to the next photo, please, page 56 in the book, 66 in e-court. Now, is this in the same pit that we were just looking at or a different pit?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the second pit, the one in the middle, and this is the top of a skull with some hair still attached on it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Did you have someone with you who was identifying these objects as human remains?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, not on -- not on this mission, but we showed the pictures, and this is considered as indeed being a soil. For the previous picture you don't need to be an anthropologist to find out that it's legs and shoes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We can go to the next page, please, 57 in the book, 67 in e-court. And which of the three pits is this in?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the one which is the most right from the previous picture, and this is a top of a body with a skull popping out of -- of a jacket, a civilian jacket.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: How long in length would you estimate that the suspect area was along the edge of the road?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Approximately 20 metres.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 58 in the book, 68 in e-court. We're going to see an aerial image entitled "Disturbed earth." There are in fact two images, one dated 5 July 1995 and one dated 27 July 1995. Can you explain the significance of this image to your investigation.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a picture that we requested after having found this area in order to ascertain the frame date of the creation of site, and on the picture at the left dated 5th of July, the round yellow marking spots the area where we have dug and found the bodies, and on the one at the right dated 27 July, one can clearly see the disturbance at the side of the road where the bodies have been dumped and also the parts that have been disturbed on the right side of the road where the excavator took the soil to cover the bodies.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: You put the yellow markings on this image; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And on the right-hand side, just to orient us, the smaller of the two boxes, which part of the site does that refer to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's the -- the right side of the road when going up to Cerska. It is the area where the excavator took the soil from the hillside to dump it on top of the bodies.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: So the longer rectangle on the left, that is the suspect area?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the burial area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to page 59 and -- in the book, 69 in e-court. And if you can talk us through the markings on this photo.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. The yellow markers in the middle, they point the size of the -- the location where we did our probing. It was to identify the -- the -- where we dug these pits. The yellow -- the yellow arrow at the right of the picture shows the direction to where the bodies fell after having been shot from the opposite side of the road where you can see two persons conducting at this moment a search for the shell casings that we found on the left side of the road. So the shooters were standing at the left and shooting at extremely short distance at people who were lined on the -- on the opposite side and who then fell along this slope. And the yellow arrow at the left points to the area of disturbance where the excavator then took the soil to cover the -- the bodies on the slope.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do the yellow numbered markers that we can see, do they run the full length of the suspect area?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, they don't. They only mark the area where we conducted the probe. The actual size of the grave was slightly longer, and our assumption, since there were three buses, was that we had to count approximately 50 people per bus, and it was a right assumption because, if I remember well, the exhumation here uncovered 150 bodies precisely, or 151. I don't remember precisely.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And do you recall what year that exhumation was done?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would think it was done shortly afterwards.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we move to the next page.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was done that year for sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, Mr. Ruez, the next section of your book relates to Nova Kasaba. We're actually going to skip over that and go to the following section. It's page 70 in the book, page 80 in e-court. If you can tell us what the significance of the red dot on this map is. Right in the centre of the map.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. This one is again the pinpointing of a reported execution site.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And where is that site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This one is just at the edge of -- of a river that goes to Drinjaca, the Drinjaca river. Just before Drinjaca river.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And do you recall the specific name of this river?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I don't. We always call it Drinjaca, but might be just before Drinjaca.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Well, how did you first hear about this site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We heard about this site from a witness who was the one who was taken in the hangar at Konjevic Polje and who claimed having then been taken with a group of 16 others in a bus, driven towards this canyon that leads to the Drinjaca river and then going north towards Zvornik where they were then stopped, unloaded, walked down a steep hill, reached the -- the edge of the river when the people, the armed people who were following them, then shot them in the back. And he shot and fell in the water, managed to float away and then gave other reference points, and so on, and managed to survive.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you see the name of that witness on the sheet in front of you, and if you can, can you read out his witness code.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: He's the witness KDZ065.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And you talked about this same witness yesterday in relation to some sites at Konjevic Polje; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. And the name of the river is Jadar, by the way.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we please go to the next page, page 71 in the book, 81 in e-court. We've seen this photo before. If you can just remind us what that building in the blue circle is, the blue square.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the blue square is the hangar of Konjevic Polje in which initially the victim was locked inside, and then put on a bus. On this picture it happens at random that there is a bus exactly there, and then this bus took the direction north, so towards Zvornik, and the canyon starts after the curve at the end of this red arrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: So the red arrow points towards the direction of Zvornik.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Towards the direction of Zvornik, but it's much before -- much, much before Zvornik. It's just at 2 -- 2 kilometres away from the intersection.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please. This is page 72 in the book, 82 in e-court. Now, Mr. Ruez, next to the red arrow we see in this picture we can see two natural lines. Can you maybe mark on this image those lines and describe what they are.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the direction -- at the top is the direction from where the bus was coming from. So this is the direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And that's the direction of Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This one is the direction of Zvornik. This line here is the road. And this one here is Jadar river.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you see the site where the witness took you to in this photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It could be just -- just under the picture or more or less -- more or less in this area here. That's quite a steep slope leading to the river.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you could just mark that little area with a 1.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And initial and date it.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. That will be Exhibit P4283.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, can we go to the next page, please, page 73 in the book, 83 in e-court. Can you describe what's on this photo, Mr. Ruez?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the little convoy that we made in order to bring the witness to -- to the spot, since without his presence this would be totally impossible for us to find, and at this moment we are arriving -- nearly arriving at the -- at the spot where the bus unloaded the prisoners.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: How far away could you approximate that you were in this photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Maybe 1, maybe 200 metres away.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next photo, please. Page 74, page 84 in e-court. Can you tell us first who took this photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I took the photo from -- it's an extract from a video that I took from helicopter of the -- the entire -- the entire crime scene areas, 70 kilometres long north/south.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can you explain the significance of the red arrow?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The arrow starts at an area which is a stop for vehicles and where the -- the bus stopped, and the arrow points towards the direction of a small path that goes down this steep slope down to the river.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, the road we see running through the middle of the picture, which direction does it head out to the left of the picture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the direction of Zvornik, and this one towards Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can you also mark in the river in this picture.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Exhibit P4284.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next payment, please, 75 in the book and 85 in e-court. If you could describe this site to us and tell us whether you found anything at this site.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the area where the -- the witness told us the execution took place, the prisoners being lined along the river and shot in the back. He -- he recognised -- he knew the one who shot him, and he gave his name in the statement, a policeman from Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Excuse me, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll not rely on his evidence of the --

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: He's introducing the various sites.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. I think it would be preferable if when answering those questions he didn't make references to the details of the witness's statement but simply pointed out that, We were led to the site by a witness who had been present. I don't think it's necessary to go beyond that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. In order to find why he came to that site. So it's necessary to hear that part, to that extent.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Right. To the extent that it was someone who was present directed him there, but the details of what occurred at the sites is not necessary, as far as we're concerned, and violates the Appeals Chamber jurisprudence.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If I can respond to that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. President, I think it's perfectly proper for Mr. Ruez to give a description of what happened at the sites insofar as it relates to his investigation, how he came to the sites, what particular features he's looking for. So I certainly don't think his evidence should be limited to just a discussion of how the site was found. There will be certain features within those sites that he's looking for.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: But he's not here to relay what he heard from the witnesses, but we'll hear -- we'll not limit his evidence insofar as it's relevant to familiarise us to the -- with the various sites.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Please carry on.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Ruez, we're going to move to another site now.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. No, sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Please, if you've got something to add.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. The question about what we found is extremely important.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The fact is that we didn't find anything there. We didn't find no human remains, might have fallen in the river like the witness, and we also didn't find shell casings in this area, and the next photo might explain the reason why.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we can go to the next page, 76 in the book and 86 in e-court. If you can just briefly explain why you took this photo.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The -- I don't have the -- the date and the year of this submission. It might have been 1998. The interest of this photo is to show that most certainly at some points of the year this -- this river doesn't look at all in the same shape. As one can see, there are big wooden logs stuck at more than 1.5 meter higher than the current flow of the river. So all the evidence we were looking for might have been washed out, washed away by the river.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We've going to move now to a new area. If I can get you to go to page 86 in your book, page 96 in e-court. We're skipping over the section on Konjevic Polje. If you can tell us what the next site is that we're going to look at.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one is in connection with a location we already went through, which is the regroupment spot of the prisoners who surrendered the 13 of July and were taken first to the meadow of -- for -- of Sandici. The red spot indicates the location of an execution site where some of these men from -- from Sandici were taken to.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, what was the first information you received that led you to investigate this sight at Kravica?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The -- the first one was a testimony that we collected during the summer 1995 from a man who claimed having been -- having surrendered, being taken to the meadow in Sandici and from there taken by foot in a large group and put inside this warehouse where he could enter what he calls a little guardhouse inside, and the reason why he survived is that when the execution took place there, he could hide under bodies and inside -- inside this -- this guardhouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you see the name of that witness on the list in front of you, and if you can, can you tell us his witness code.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. So this first witness is KDZ071.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The -- the --

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Please go on.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The second witness, we could only access him beginning of the following year, after the month of March, when the total process of exchange of prisoners was over. And this particular witness had managed to flee after having survived the execution at Kravica warehouse. He could flee to Zepa. He was taken prisoner in Zepa but not identified as coming from Srebrenica and could tell his story after having been released after the month of March 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And what's his witness code, if you can see it there?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: He is the witness KDZ063.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next page at page 87 in the book and 97 in e-court. And if you can tell us where this photo is taken from and what the red arrow is pointing to.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This photograph is taken from the reference point that we named the destroyed house that is along the asphalt road at the Sandici meadow. And from there it gives an idea of the distance towards the Kravica warehouse. The Kravica warehouse is this white spot that is pointed to by the red arrow on the picture, and at the left it is the asphalt road leading towards Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next photo, page 88, page 98 in e-court. Again, if you can describe this photo to us.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This one is photo from helicopter that gives a better feeling of the distance. It's a short distance, approximately 1 kilometre by foot or by vehicle from Sandici meadow. But Sandici meadow is just right under the -- this -- this picture, just at the -- at the left of -- the bottom of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page. Page 89 in the book, 99 in e-court. If you can describe this and then orient us on the road that we can see running down the bottom half of the picture.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: At the -- at the right of the blue arrow is the direction of the meadow of Sandici, so the direction of Konjevic Polje. And the arrow points towards the direction of Bratunac. This is the direction the arrow is, the direction of the -- of the prisoners when they arrived at the -- at the warehouse. They arrived in two different groupings. The first group arrived -- small group arrived by buses. It is the one in which the second witness was, the witness KDZ063. And the buses unloaded them in front of the east part of -- sorry, west part of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And if -- this is the warehouse within the red box?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the warehouse complex. It's several buildings, but the building of relevance is the one that is parallel to the roads in the red rectangle.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we go to the next page, please, page 90 in the book and 100 in e-court. We have a split image here.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can tell us first what time of year was the image at the top taken.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The -- the one at the top is the one that is dated at the closest date possible of the events. It's a picture that was taken in January 1996. The one at the bottom was taken much later, maybe 1997, maybe even 1998. One can see at the bottom a destroyed part of the warehouse is now reconstructed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And the area that you've outlined in the red box, is that the east end -- what you refer to as the east end or the west end of the warehouse?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The -- this is the part where the larger group of the people who arrived by foot were taken. So the second -- the second group. And the part that is marked is the east part -- the west part, sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, in this -- this trip you made --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Did I say east here? I'm a bit confused at this point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: You corrected as west.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We have it in the transcript as "the west end."

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it's the east end.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: You said earlier on the arrow, blue arrow, was from Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think that's sufficient.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Okay. I'm a bit lost, I must confess.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: This is always confusing.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, this trip in January 1996, did you do anything at the warehouse? Did you go into the warehouse and do any investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was an extremely short mission, because in fact we use the opportunity of a short one-day trip made by Mr. John Shattuck in the area. Mr. Shattuck was Under-Secretary of State for human rights of the US government, and the aim of the mission was to show implementation of Dayton agreement by freedom of movement, the freedom of movement being at that time only for press people, to be honest, but it gave a wonderful opportunity to go with him in order to show him various sites and have a first look at them. So at this particular site, meanwhile Mr. Shattuck was keeping the press people busy for a short interview, I entered the warehouse with a colleague and we scratched a sample of suspect substance that was all over these walls in order to determine if we were in front of an animal slaughterhouse or if indeed this place had been an execution place of human beings, so human blood.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And what were the -- the results -- first, did you have those analysed?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The sample was taken to a Dutch forensic lab, and the result was that the sample was human blood.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we go to the next page, please, page 91 in the book and 101 in e-court. And just very briefly, if you can --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one is the west part, the direction of Bratunac, and this is where the first group on board of buses were taken to. So this one is more open space. There is no -- no door to -- to lock this area, so the people were brought to be sitting at this west end of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, page 92 in the book and 102 in e-court. The picture in the bottom right is an aerial dated 13 July 1995, approximately 1400 hours. If you can describe the significance of what's in the yellow circle.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. So this is an aerial surveillance imagery dated 13, and on this one we can see two buses parked at the west part of the warehouse precisely at the location where the -- the second witness declared having been taken to by bus.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can you just tell us -- remind us again which witness that was.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The KDZ063.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: How about asking the witness to mark on this aerial image. Which direction is to the -- is the Sandici meadow?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So which way -- which direction is the east?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Why don't we keep this as --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The reference.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. We'll keep it as next exhibit. Give the number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4285, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could we go back to page 86, e-court 96, I take it.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: It was what I was --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Do you see -- do you see Bratunac and Sandici? Yes, Bratunac is in the east, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Would you like to correct your -- yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I reversed the thing. Yes, I totally reversed it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Shall we bring it up? Shall we bring it up, the exhibit we just saw, P4285. Would you like to correct the east and west.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Probably you need to push the button.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I need to push again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: But could you wait a minute. Yes. Push it again. Just a second.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. President, perhaps we could go back. I could have Mr. Ruez mark a clean copy if that would be of assistance.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Because it's in the transcript, I think I would prefer that he correct this.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: I'd prefer corrections on that one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue, Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Make sure that we keep this.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we can go to the next page, please. It's page 93 in the book and 103 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, we've seen this photo before.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I've not the good one on the screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: It's page 103.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, 93 in hard copy.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Ninety-three in hard copy, 103 in e-court.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We've seen this picture before. Can you just explain briefly why this is in your book again.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it's the same explanation, so this one is the west. That's where the largest group was taken to, and this is where the witness KDZ071 was taken to.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page, please, page 94 in the book and 104 in e-court. Can you tell us what date this photo was taken?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was in 1996. It was the first mission where we entered the warehouse in order to do a preliminary collection of samples in order to secure what we could collect inside in case any event would prevent us to return and more fully process the place with an expert team, another expert team fully dedicated for that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And which end of the warehouse is this in, if you recall?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the -- the west part of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: What are the yellow arrows pointing to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: They -- they point to locations where samples were taken and that we suspected to be human blood and hair, skin, pieces of skin, things like this.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Were these the samples that you referred to earlier that you said were tested?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. The -- during the very short entering of this place in January, I didn't even take a photograph of the sample. I just took the sample. It was just to check if we were talking about animal or human blood in this place.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: But these particular samples here, were they taken and tested, or you're just -- the arrows are just pointing to them?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. They were labelled, given ERN numbers and kept just in case we could not return, but this place was later that year fully processed by experts from the US navy service and who have filed a complete report about the hundreds of samples that they took in this -- in this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page, please, page 95 in hard copy, 105 in e-court. Again, is this in the west end of the warehouse?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It is still the west end. So the picture is not as good quality as the original one, but you can see on this a lot of blood spills on the wall, as well as black traces that were determined being from explosive residues, confirming the fact that grenades had been also thrown inside the warehouse, not only shots fired.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: At page 96 in the hard copy and 106 in e-court, please. Now, can you tell us what this is and where it was found?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a live grenade that was found in -- in the grassy area just in front of the warehouse, in between the asphalt road and the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall when this photo was taken?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was taken in 1996. It could be a mission of June 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry, no. There is a date on another picture which was taken during the same mission. It was April 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you. Page 97 in the hard copy, 107 in e-court, please. Could you talk us through what this photo shows, what the number 2 is, what the item with the writing on it is, and then the object in the middle?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a grenade handle of -- that was -- when they attached to a grenade, and that is a part that stays behind once the grenade is thrown. The grenade explodes, but the spoon stays. And this spoon was found at the back of the warehouse, so at the north-west part of the warehouse, at the back of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And what's the -- the piece of paper in front with the writing on it? Can you briefly explain what that is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is a sheet that goes together with -- with the piece of evidence in order to label the date and hour it was taken. And as you can see from the agency ICTY, the case number for this specific case, KV-3, Kravica-3, and the name of the person who took the picture.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Mitchell, I note the time. We're going to take a break now.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Certainly.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If it is convenient.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: It is convenient.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Before that, can I draw your attention to the pages 78 -- from 78 to 85 in hard copy. Were those sites included in the indictment sites?

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. President, there's two sites in this which are not in the indictment, Nova Kasaba and Konjevic Polje, and we skipped over those two sets of photos.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Why were they included in the book?

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: They were included because -- simply because this is an exhibit that was created by Mr. Ruez for the Popovic trial --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: -- and we have simply used the same exhibit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Thank you. We'll take a break for 20 minutes and resume at half past 10.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Robinson.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, thank you, Mr. President. I'd like to introduce one of our legal interns, Nastexo Muxumed, from the United Kingdom, who is joining us this section.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Mitchell. Please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, just a couple of extra questions on this photo, page 97 in the book. Can you explain what the yellow tag with the number 2 on it is? The yellow object we can see in the -- in the photo.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. These markers designate the number of the -- of the exhibit, of the piece of evidence. Mr. Prosecutor, I would like to make an additional correction to the directions we were pointing to previously, because the picture was totally reversed from my usual reference points, and I made an additional mistake not only inversing east and west but also therefore inversed south and north. So when I said the back of the warehouse was north, in reality it's opposite. It's south. So the grenade handle found at the back of the warehouse was, in fact, found south-west of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: An additional little thing also. When I talk about the spoon of a grenade, the spoon is the French word for it, but I translate it as a spoon, but in English it's a grenade handle.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Was this the only grenade handle you found, the one that we can see in this picture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. We found a few of them. Probably four or five of them.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Were they concentrated in one area, or were they spread out?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: They were concentrated in the south-west area, underneath two windows.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, page 98 in the hard copy and 108 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, this photo and the next one, which is page 99 in your book, show a hole in the warehouse wall. Were you able to determine what this hole was and what may have caused it?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: There was a statement claiming that shots were fired inside, grenades thrown inside, and even an RPG-style antitank rockets fired inside. So that hole could have been consistent with that, especially on the following picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the following picture, page 99, 109 in e-court.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Where one can see the fact that some explosion occurred in this wall from inside towards outside. And if indeed this would be caused by such a weapon, it might very well be that it could have been fired from the window that one can see at the -- in the line of sight through this hole, but -- it's just a possible consistency, but I would not say for sure that this was the case.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next page, page 100, 110 in e-court. And if you can explain to us the significance of the entrance which the yellow arrow is pointing to.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the -- the facade, the front facade of the warehouse, and as the witness claimed having been able to hide inside a so-called guardhouse inside, this is the location where we found traces of what was previously a guardhouse inside, and the arrow points to that specific location.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Well, let's go to the next page, page 101, 111 in e-court. If you can describe this to us.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The fact is that after the first short entering the warehouse in January, I then had to tell to the witness that there was an inconsistency in his story since we didn't see any -- anything that looked like a guardhouse inside. But the fact is also that on the next mission we had more time, and this was the obvious traces of what is left of what was before the little bulldozer entered the place and cleaned the bodies and most probably destroyed this structure. One can see where it was with the blue little tiles at the bottom and the traces on the wall that show where this structure was constructed inside this warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can you just tell us the date that this particular photo was taken.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This one has the date on it. It was the 12 April 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you also tell us if you can see the witness code of the witness you're talking about. If you can read that out for us.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. He's the witness KDZ071.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we go to the next page please, 102 in the hard copy, 112 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, I might ask you to mark on the image what the items are we see here, and if you can also tell us where they were found?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So just in front of the warehouse on the right hand there was an area of rubbish, and we -- we went through this -- all this rubbish and found some items that had been left behind after the -- the cleaning process of the inside on which we can see shell casings, fake teeth, "licna karta" but without name inside, and a collection of bone fragments that were shown to the anthropologist who determined it was pieces of human bones.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can circle the area of the bone fragments.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall the name of the anthropologist who made those identifications?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It was William Haglund.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can put your initials on that and date it, Mr. Ruez, please.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. This will be admitted as the next Prosecution exhibit.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4286, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I would not be able to say if the identification was done on the spot during this mission or based on the photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we go to the next page, please, 103 in the hard copy and 113. Now, this is the same as photo number 91, which we've seen earlier, and this is introducing the other end of the warehouse; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that is correct. This is the -- the east part of the warehouse. That is more an open space.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 104 in the hard copy and 114 in e-court. Can you describe what we're looking at in this photo.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the east wall of the -- the hangar, the wall that was behind the prisoners.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we have the next photo, please. Now, this is 105 in the hard copy. If you can tell us what that yellow arrow on the right-hand side of the photo is pointing to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this arrow points to a bloodstain from where I collected a sample. The reason why I had to take this sample is that I discovered after the forensic process that was done by the team of experts in this place during the -- the summer 1996 that they had processed the entire west part of the warehouse but, unfortunately, had forgotten to do the east part. So I returned to the east part just in order to collect at least one sample in order to have the lab determine if this was human blood or not, and it ended up indeed being also human blood.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And we can see some other marks on that wall. Were you able to determine what those other marks were?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The wall is also riddled with obvious bullet holes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, 106 in the hard copy, 116 in e-court. Is this just a close-up of the blood sample that we see in the previous page?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct. It's only a close shot of the sample.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we go to page 107 in the hard copy, please, 117 in e-court. Can you describe what we're looking at here, Mr. Ruez, and the significance of the window that the yellow arrow is pointing to.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The -- the witness who claims having survived in this east part of the warehouse said having jumped out of -- of a window at the back of the warehouse, and this is the -- the arrow points to the window the witness was referring to. He's the witness KDZ063.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, did you actually go to the site with this witness, or did he identify it in some other way?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We unfortunately couldn't return to the site with the witness, but he identified the photograph and said that he jumped through the first window in that part of the warehouse, and this is the -- this is the first one. The closest to the area where the prisoners were sitting when they were shot at.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we look at page 108 in hard copy and 118 in e-court. If you can tell us what angle we're looking at the warehouse from now.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this photo shows the back of the warehouse and the first window is again the one where the witness jumped out. He said that behind was a cornfield. In -- at the time we came there is no more corn, but it was indeed before that a cornfield. One could see the cut corn behind it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, can you actually mark the window you're referring to on this photo so we can be clear.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Took the wrong pen. [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can initial and date that as well, please.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If that can be admitted, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Exhibit P4287.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we look at page 109 in the hard copy now and page 119 in e-court. If you can tell us, Mr. Ruez, which part of the warehouse we're about to see and what, if anything, is significant about this particular photo.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is again the east part but seen from the road, so the front facade of this warehouse. Behind this window is the area where the prisoners were sitting, and the goal of this one is to show that the witness I was referring to was most probably not the only one who tried to escape the killers by jumping through a window since we will have a close shot of this one that will indicate that someone also jumped out of this window.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, 110 in the hard copy and 120 in e-court. And if you can explain what this is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So on the previous picture it was not obvious because of the distance, but just underneath this window is a shoe trace on the wall, and one can see that it is a reversed shoe print. So it's not someone who climbed inside, but it is someone who jumped outside. I could point you the location on the previous one now.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Yes. If we can go back to page 109, page 119, and if you can mark on that image where that shoe print is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And initial and date it, please.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That will be Exhibit P4288.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And just to be crystal clear for our records, this is not the window which the witness who you spoke to jumped out of. This is a different window.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This one jumped in the wrong direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to page 111 in the hard copy, and 121. If you can just tell us very briefly what this image is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a still extracted from the video of Zoran Petrovic, one of the pictures that he tried to conceal from the Tribunal. On this one he's just arriving on the spot together with Colonel Borovcanin, and at the moment he arrives, he films for a few seconds before shutting down his camera, and this is the -- the entrance at the front west of the warehouse where one can see a Bosnian Serb soldier just in front at the right hand of the picture and a stack of dead bodies of people who most probably tried to exit the place once the shooting started and who are piled up at the entrance.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next page, 112 in the hard copy and 122 in e-court. And can you explain to us the relationship between these three photos.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So at the top is the entrance as it looked like at the time of the events. At the bottom left is the door as it looked like after the events. This destruction matches the part of the story explaining that after the shooting that occurred in several waves was over, a bulldozer entered the location in order to collect the bodies. So the destruction on that door shows the necessity to having enlarged the entrance for this machine to get inside.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And the August 1997 shot.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one shows the reconstruction of that part of the warehouse, but it was not reconstructed at the identical compared with how it was in July 1995. It is more large now than it was at the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay, well, let's go --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a couple of questions, Mr. Ruez. You said Mr. Zoran Petrovic, he tried to conceal that part from the Tribunal. Do you remember having said that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: What would be your basis to say so?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Because when he mounted his film for broadcast, he eliminated from that film the part that were the most relevant, those part on which we could see prisoners, the ones in Bratunac, those sitting on the balcony of the white house. And most important of all, he erased from that film the piece of footage that shows the ongoing execution happening when he arrives at the Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. And my second question is this: You said: "At the entrance, at the front west of the warehouse where one can see a Bosnian Serb soldier just in front at the right hand the picture and a stack of dead bodies of people who most probably tried to exit the place once the shooting started and who are piled up at the entrance." What would be the basis for such observation?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The basis is that the people were jammed inside that part of the warehouse, and since these bodies are -- are shot outside the warehouse, it can only be because they tried to get out of this place to avoid the shooting.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Do you think the door is open on this picture?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, it is. I would think there was -- there has never been a door. It's an open space.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we can go to the next payment, please, 113 in the hard copy and 123 in e-court. And if you can just briefly explain this picture, and we're going to go through a series of pictures quickly here to show the reconstruction of the door.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This one is to indicate that once reconstructed, the door is not at the original size it had at the time of the events since a piece of it is now missing. One can clearly see it by comparing the bullet traces on the -- on the original photograph at the time of the events, the one at the top, and how it looked like later on. So a big piece of it is missing.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 114 in hard copy and 124 in e-court. Can you explain the significance of these two lines, the white line and the yellow line.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It's -- it's reference point to -- to -- again to then try to check the original size of the door.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next photo, please, 115 in hard copy and 125 in e-court. And if you can briefly explain this one to us?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So this one I made in order to determine in fact what were the parts that were -- that were missing.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, 116, and 126 in e-court. Does this also relate to the --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, the same situation. It's to make sure that indeed the picture that we see, the still one, though the size is not the one that we could observe later, is sill indeed the relevant part of the warehouse we are talking about.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: At page 117, please, 127 in e-court. Can you explain to us the relationship between those two photos.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The -- the main interest of the -- of this one is that once the journalist under Colonel Borovcanin arrived on the spot, the picture above shows what's the status of the bullet holes on this warehouse. Since on the video, original video, shots can be heard, there would be two options. It could be any combat going on in the area. It could be what is called a happy fire, but it could also be shots being fired at the prisoners. So when one looks at how the situation was after this video, one can see that there are in fact more holes in the wall than at the moment the first picture during the live events was taken.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we can go to the next page. I think this illustrates it better. Page 118, 128 in e-court. Can you just explain the significance of the red circles in the bottom image?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The red circles show additional bullet holes, additional holes that were shot at the wall after the photograph of the video taken by Zoran Petrovic. There are three more in this area precisely, there are three more -- four more shots on the wall.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We're going to look at some video now of the Kravica warehouse. This is 65 ter 40231, a -- and, Mr. Ruez, we're going to turn off the sound and if you can talk us through what this video shows.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Perhaps you can tell us right up front who took this video.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It could either be me or Peter Nicholson. I don't remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Who is Peter Nicholson?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Peter Nicholson was a staff member of the Office of the Prosecutor, and he accompanied me on all the 1996 and mainly also most of the 1997 missions in this area, but he was not, let's say, a purely member of the investigation team. He was doing other things, but he agreed to come on the missions.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay. Let's -- we stopped the footage briefly at 41 seconds. If we can restart, and then, Mr. Ruez, if you can tell us what we are looking at?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: At this part, I was the one filming. Later on at the warehouse, it was Peter Nicholson. So this one shows the -- showed previously the Sandici meadow with the reference point of the destroyed house, and -- this was of the destroyed house, the meadow being in the back. So turning the camera in a way that was more or less the one of the previous video. The asphalt road going -- leading towards the direction of Bratunac and the Kravica warehouse. And here the same view that we had on the still, which is the direction of the warehouse at the end of the white spot in the middle of the picture where I'm zooming on. Again to show the walking distance of the second group. So that's from the helicopter mission. It shows the valley at the left, Bratunac; the right direction, Konjevic Polje. Here is the warehouse complex. It shows the area where the witness who jumped out of the window then escaped going towards the hill behind.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Did you do any investigation at the other buildings that are part of this complex?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just a visual check, nothing conclusive, and we -- I mean, there was no -- no traces that could indicate something happening then, and no witness information about it also. So this is the facade. Here we are in the process of checking the surroundings for shell casings, grenade holders -- handles. The -- as you can notice, the exit doors have a large concentration of bullet holes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you tell us when this footage was taken? We can see that the end door still hasn't been reconstructed.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I -- no. I don't know for this one. That was -- so it's filmed by Peter Nicholson, because I just saw myself taking pictures. There's the frame that we saw on the -- on the still photo, the frame of the previous guardhouse inside. There were some traces of blood even at the ceiling.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And this is the inside of the west end of the warehouse; is that right?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is right, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: For the record, we're around 4 minutes, 40 seconds.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So the place has never suffered any major change. All the traces were left behind, and many years later the same collection process of evidence could have been redone with the same amount of human blood, human skin, human hair, traces of explosives. Everything was left in the same condition years after. So this is the back of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We're now at around 5 minutes and 50 seconds on the video.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the cornfield behind the -- the warehouse. This is a zoom on a shell casing. There were several still scattered around. A shell casing. Another shell casing. So the quality is not really good because at that time we had video cameras without steady shots, so it's always trembling and ... So now again the front of the warehouse. The east part.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We're at around 7 minutes, 45 seconds.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So entering the east part and the prisoners were at the left of it where the -- not in this direction. That was the direction towards the open space. And now it's turning towards the -- the area where the prisoners were, this area here.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We might stop there, 8 minutes, 50.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. President, if I can tender that clip.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. That will be admitted.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4289, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, that finished the section on the Kravica warehouse. We're going to move now to -- back to your book, 65 ter 3199, and if we can look at page 119 in the hard copy and 129 in e-court. What we're about to see is an aerial image of Bratunac city. And if you can just briefly tell us who put those yellow markings on there, and then I think there's a better photo of Bratunac that we'll take a quick look at.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is an aerial photograph dated 12 July. The interest of it is only to point various locations of relevance.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Well, why don't -- why don't we go to page 272 in the hard copy. It's the very back page of the book. 282 in e-court. If we can rotate that to the left. Maybe scroll down a little bit. Okay. If you can explain to us the significance of these sites that are marked here.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So, this is in order to spot in Bratunac town the main -- the main places of -- of interest and where prisoners were locked into, the locations of the buses, lines of buses that were in various parts of this small town, so under the eyes of everyone. Everyone was aware of what was going on in this small area due to the amount of people jammed on the inside.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Sorry, if I stop you there for a moment. What is the basis of your knowledge that this is where the buses were?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's a combination of mainly two sources, those who were inside the locations or in lines of buses and also locations that were spotted by the UN soldiers who were kept in Bratunac during these days and who moved, for example, to go to the Bratunac Brigade for some of them who saw buses in front.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay. We can see on the left of the picture the old school, the hangar, and the Vuk Karadzic school marked there.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. These are the locations we already went through previously. In addition, it spots the lines of buses in front of the Vihor garage, also in front of the Vuk Karadzic school, a line of bus. Very close to the Hotel Fontana, which is the hotel where during the 12 and -- yeah, the 11th in the evening and the 12th in the morning where the meetings with the so-called representatives of Srebrenica who were called in by General Mladic. An interesting spot also is the location of the office of Miroslav Deronjic, who was the SDS leader, in this -- in this area right in the middle of where the situation took place. And there is one -- one spot that we did not mark because the information was confirmed later. We had information that people had been taken to a place I never talked about, which is the soccer field, and it's only after the guilty plea of Momir Nikolic that we could confirm, since there was no one who survived the situation, that the prisoners were taken to the soccer field and executed there.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Perhaps you can just mark for us on this image where the soccer field is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And just initial and date it.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: This is also part of aerial images provided by the US?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, absolutely. Not exactly provided by the US. In fact, it is aerial imagery that was used by the US forces in the area as a kind of operational map, supportive map. It was not done specifically for our purpose.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So it was not taken on the day of 12th of July?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: We have no date for this one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So you marked buses on several places in this. Whether you, or -- I'm not sure whether it was you, but do you see buses on this picture?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Absolutely not. It's a visual spotting of buses according to the testimonies.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If I can tender that marked image.
